angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 31,863,060 km at 1327.30 pc = 0.32 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, XX Sgr: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1327.3 +/- 77.2 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1327.3 +/- 77.2 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.6870 +/- 0.0271 mas (same row, RUWE 1.10), 25.4 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 45.8 +/- 2.7 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, XX Sgr: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 45.8 +/- 2.7 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 31,863,060 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5625 +/- 367 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 276, Name='XX Sgr', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5625 +/- 367 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 276, Name='XX Sgr', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5625 +/- 367 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 1.3 from 2023A&A...678A.195D, the median of its 12 spectra; the 18 published values span log g 1 to 1.89, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.6% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A%26A...678A.195D)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, coloured from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
